source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
The published record for this Alpharetta campus contains one technical figure: 184,553 square feet of technical space. No IT load in megawatts is published on the operator's spec page, so no power-based estimate of rack or accelerator count can be derived. Square footage alone does not determine AI suitability, because the same floor area can support anything from low-density storage to high-density GPU clusters depending on power density, cooling architecture, and structural loading, none of which are published here. The operator name is also not published on the spec page this site has read.

Because no megawatt figure is published for this campus, it does not contribute to the 42 MW total that this site has recorded across Georgia's two facilities with published capacity. Georgia has 33 mapped facilities in total, and only 2 of those publish a megawatt figure. This campus ranks third by published megawatts in the state, which in practice means it falls below the two facilities that do publish a figure, not that it has been measured and found smaller. The ranking reflects an absence of data, not a confirmed position.

No certifications are listed in the published specifications, so no compliance tier can be read from this record. A campus of 184,553 square feet of technical space is large enough to be material to AI infrastructure if the power and cooling to match that footprint exist, but whether they do is not answerable from what the operator has published. A reader making a site decision would need to request the power capacity, the cooling design, and any relevant certifications directly from the operator.
